cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1 to D3 in docs. (1) packages/bee/LEADER.md, section Work in parallel, coordinate through the store: directly after the agents-other-project-to-its-leader block, add a block marked like the others with rule id agents-cli-before-mcp. Content, as bullets in the doctrine's plain style: a tool that ships a CLI and MCP tools is reached through its CLI first and the MCP tool is the fallback, because the CLI runs the same handler and puts far less text in context. mcp-gateway: `mcp-gateway tools <keywords>` (MCP search_tools), `mcp-gateway describe <upstream.tool>` (get_tool_definition), `mcp-gateway call [--text] <upstream.tool> '<json>'` (call_tool); a tool that is not read-only still needs the user's yes. Skillstation: `skillstation skill show <id> --json` loads a hub skill (MCP skill_get) — follow its content field, only when manifest.status is active; call skill_get when the content sends you to a relative file of the skill (the write guard refuses reads inside the hub folder, and skill_get copies the skill to a readable cache), when the status is not active, or when the hub is on another machine; skill_resolve and skill_feedback have no CLI verb and stay on MCP. Fallback: the binary is not on PATH, the verb is unknown (exit 2), a guard or permission refuses the shell call, or the call fails with a tool error. After `mcp-gateway call` exits 1 with code outcome_unknown, never repeat it through call_tool: read the system state first. A subagent with no shell uses the MCP tool. waggledance has its own mapping in rule agents-other-project-to-its-leader. (2) Rule index in router-triage-and-the-agents-md-duplication-boundary.md: add the agents-cli-before-mcp row after the agents-other-project-to-its-leader row, same shape (home, spoken line, applied_at), citing cli-before-mcp D1, D2, D3 (history D-numbers, never raw ids). (3) skillstation-hub-skills-and-aliases.md: in Write an alias and in the skillstation.principles business rule, say the alias and the hub principle header name skillstation skill show <id> --json first and skill_get as the fallback, cite cli-before-mcp D3 and D4, and add that orient's playbook pointer and the agent tools line keep skill_get (D4). (4) Run `bee dev regen` so .bee/LEADER.md and the generated outputs follow; restore any hub-served skill under .claude/skills that regen re-rendered. Plain English, ASD-STE100 style, no code comments. Proof: the cell verify; quote the counts.
